messages:
auditor_paul: Hi team — ISO/SOC2 fieldwork: we need an evidence bundle that links RBAC edits (k8s RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding + IAM policy commits) to KMS operations (Decrypt, GenerateDataKey, ReEncrypt) for the window 2025-09-01T00:00Z -> 2025-09-04T00:00Z. Required: chain-of-custody (per-file SHA256), signed manifest, short control-mapping doc to SOC2 CC6/CC7 and ISO A.9/A.12, and a tiny sanitized sample row.

adina: We can do that. Quick questions: include infra-as-code (terraform apply) and internal admin UI events? Also, do you accept cosign or do you require KMS-signed manifest?

auditor_paul: Include terraform and admin UI. KMS-signed manifest is preferred; cosign/GPG optional as an additional notarization. Consolidated bundle across prod regions is fine.

chris: Plan: 1) export CloudTrail for KMS events (Decrypt, GenerateDataKey, ReEncrypt, CreateGrant), 2) k8s audit entries for RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding changes, 3) admin-ui audit, 4) terraform run diffs, 5) OPA policy-eval logs (to show policy deny/allow if RBAC change was gated). Produce raw CSVs + redacted CSVs, correlation.csv, scoring_rules.md, control_map.md, README.md, manifest.json.

adina: Splunk queries I will run (prod):
```spl
index=cloudtrail (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=ReEncrypt OR eventName=CreateGrant)
| eval ts=_time
| table ts, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.keyId, requestParameters.keyAlias, sourceIPAddress, userAgent, awsRegion
| sort ts
```
```spl
index=k8s_audit (objectRef.resource=rolebindings OR objectRef.resource=clusterrolebindings)
| table _time, user.username, verb, objectRef.resource, objectRef.name, requestObject
```
```spl
index=admin_ui_audit OR index=terraform_runs OR index=opa_eval
| table _time, actor, action, details
```

chris: Correlation approach: time window default +/- 240s, token_issuer (OIDC sub/iss) match, service-account annotation check, ip/user-agent similarity, terraform run id match, and OPA policy correlation. We'll compute correlation_score (0-1) with weights documented in scoring_rules.md. We'll attach a reproducible SQL-like join and the script used to normalize IDs.

\auditor_paul: Important: annotate any ephemeral-key usage (aliases like alias/ephemeral/*) and flag CreateGrant events. Also include incident linkage for INC-20250902-1 (brief autoscaler rollback during the window).

adina: Noted. Staging (unsigned) bundle path: s3://redwood-compliance/temp/1905009999-keystore-proof.zip. Contents: cloudtrail.csv, k8s_audit.csv, admin_ui.csv, terraform_runs.csv, opa_eval.csv, correlation.csv, scoring_rules.md, control_map.md, README.md, manifest.json. We'll compute per-file SHA256 and put entries in manifest.json. Then sign manifest twice: primary with KMS (alias/audit-sign) and secondary with cosign (optional) for cross-check. Example commands in README.

chris: Minimal pseudo-join I will run in analytics cluster:
```sql
SELECT r._time AS rb_time,
       r.user_username AS rb_actor,
       r.objectRef_name AS rb_object,
       r.verb AS rb_change_type,
       k.ts AS kms_time,
       k.userIdentity_arn AS kms_actor,
       k.requestParameters_keyId AS key_id,
       k.requestParameters_keyAlias AS key_alias,
       compute_score(...) AS correlation_score,
       inc.incident_id AS incident_id,
       's3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1905009999/manifest.json.kms.sig' AS manifest_ref
FROM k8s_audit r
LEFT JOIN cloudtrail k ON abs(r._time - k.ts) <= 240
LEFT JOIN admin_ui_audit a ON a._time BETWEEN r._time - 300 AND r._time + 300
LEFT JOIN terraform_runs t ON t.run_id = extract_tf_ref(r.requestObject)
LEFT JOIN opa_eval o ON o.request_id = r.request_id
LEFT JOIN incident_index inc ON inc.window CONTAINS r._time;
```

\auditor_paul: Please include redaction rules (emails -> sha256, IP last octet masked) and retention notes (CloudTrail 180d, k8s_audit 90d, admin_ui 365d, terraform_runs 365d, opa_eval 90d).

adina: Will include README.md with redaction policy and a sanitized sample row. Sanitary sample (emails hashed, ids truncated):
"rbac_1729001001 | 3f5b... (redacted email hash) | RoleBinding:prod-autoscaler | patch | kms_1729001020 | svc-account-autoscaler | key/ff12-xxxx | alias/ephemeral/autoscaler | 0.94 | INC-20250902-1 | s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1905009999/manifest.json.kms.sig"

evidence-bot: INCIDENT 2025-09-02T03:12Z - autoscaler rollback recorded. ID: INC-20250902-1

\chris: Signing flow (example):
```bash
# compute file hashes
sha256sum cloudtrail.csv k8s_audit.csv ... > manifest.json
# KMS sign
aws kms sign --key-id alias/audit-sign --message fileb://manifest.json --signature fileb://manifest.json.kms.sig
# optional cosign notarization
cosign sign-blob --key /keys/cosign.key --payload manifest.json --output-signature manifest.json.cosign.sig
# upload
aws s3 cp ./1905009999-keystore-proof.zip s3://redwood-compliance/temp/
aws s3 mv s3://redwood-compliance/temp/1905009999-keystore-proof.zip s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1905009999-keystore-proof.zip
```

\auditor_paul: ETA for the signed bundle? Also please ensure the manifest includes the sha256 for each file and that the manifest itself is signed.

\adina: ETA ~6 hours. We'll DM presigned link when the signed bundle is in evidence/. If anything blocks, I'll @auditor_paul directly. Thanks. :thumbsup:
